psychic-skill-psybeam.name: Psybeam
psychic-skill-psybeam.description: New skill: a psychic beam along a line (Power 45); Confused 2 turns.

psychic-magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
psychic-magic-guard.description: Immune to Poison and Burn; +1 Sp. Def.

psychic-precognition.name: Precognition
psychic-precognition.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP; +1 Speed.

psychic-skill-extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
psychic-skill-extrasensory.description: New skill: a quick ranged psychic strike.

psychic-skill-hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
psychic-skill-hypnosis.description: New skill: puts a foe to Sleep for 2 turns (a hit wakes it).

psychic-minds-eye.name: Mind's Eye
psychic-minds-eye.description: Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon in the way.

psychic-skill-expanding-force.name: Expanding Force
psychic-skill-expanding-force.description: New skill: a psychic blast that hits a foe and everything around it.

psychic-surge.name: Psychic Surge
psychic-surge.description: Psychic moves deal 25% more damage; +25% damage against Sleeping foes.

psychic-telepathy.name: Telepathy
psychic-telepathy.description: +20% damage against foes carrying an ally's status (combo); +1 Sp. Def.

psychic-inner-focus.name: Inner Focus
psychic-inner-focus.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it each turn; +1 Sp. Atk.

psychic-skill-future-sight.name: Future Sight
psychic-skill-future-sight.description: New Bond skill: a foreseen psychic strike up to 3 hexes, ignoring line of sight.
